title: Redeem NAB Reward Points - 370k
body:
Hi there,
After some suggestion on where to use the NAB reward points accumulated over the years before the 1st October changes. So we have about 370k NAB reward points (1st lot is expiring in 2027).
I am yet to get my head around the impact to our scenario however it seems around the October change, NAB will allocate more points to us based on the balance at that date to ensure we are no worse of as redeem rate post October will change as well.
We have looked the redeemed options, and apart from grocery gift cards (e.g. coles) not seeing much value. Not sure should we redeem these before October change.
Any suggestions to effectively use these points would be helpful.
Cheers
